change.item: First stable release. From 1.0, setting names and values only change in a new major version; minor versions add features and patch versions fix bugs.

Clearer setting names: Front/Back Text Color (front_text_color, back_text_color, on the element and on items), Back List Icon and Back List Icon Color (back_list_icon, back_list_icon_color, back_list_icon_lucide). Older layouts are migrated automatically when they load, dynamic content mappings included.

Keyboard and screen readers: the box itself is no longer a focusable "button" around links. Each box has a real toggle button (read out, not shown; "Show the back" with the front title) for both triggers, and a click anywhere on a Click box still turns it. The side that is turned away is inert, so its links can't be reached with Tab.
The Hover trigger option is called Hover; keyboard users use the toggle button.

fix.item: Title HTML Element only accepts h1-h6 and div (h1 and h6 added to the list).
The link of the plain HTML copy stored for search is escaped.

addition.item: Display options in the Content tab, as in YOOtheme's own elements: show or hide the front title, front content, image, icon, back title, back content, back list and link of all items without deleting them.
Lucide Icon fields, with Icon Pro installed: Lucide icons instead of the UIkit icons for the item and for the back list.

note.item: No changes to this element. The version follows the shared Elemen 0.7.0 release, whose common plugin code gained support for YOOtheme event listeners. From here on this element has its own version.

addition.item: Back List: one feature per line on the back, shown with an icon and color set on the element.
3D Depth: the content floats above the box while it turns (flip effects only).

change.item: The item's Content tab is a plain list of fields, with Front and Back in the labels, so editors and image pickers get the full width.
The slide-left effect follows the text direction in right-to-left languages.

addition.item: Multiple flip boxes in one element: content per item, style and grid settings once on the element. Grid columns per screen size, matching heights and a delay between items.
Each item can set its own front and back background and text color.

change.item: Layouts made with 0.3 are converted when they load: the box becomes the first item, so pages look the same.

addition.item: First release: a two-sided box with flip, slide, fade and zoom effects on hover, keyboard focus, click or tap.
